name: 1-kettlebell-single-leg-deadlift
instructions:
1. Begin with a kettlebell in one hand contralateral (opposite) to the stance leg.
2. Begin the movement by lifting one foot, unlocking your knee, and slowly hinging at the opposite hip.
3. Hinge until your chest is almost parallel to the floor and don’t allow the kettlebell to drift forward excessively.
4. Push through the floor and extend the hip as your return to the starting position.
5. Reset and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
